views.front: Soft seat loft and separated back pads improve the tailored chair while preserving the metal frame.
views.rear: Dark rear shell, arm rails and central pedestal remain connected and aligned.
views.detail: Seat seam follows the cushion edge without floating ends; shallow cushion shaping avoids a blocky slab.
views.underside: Seat support, swivel stem, five spokes and caster feet remain distinct.
views.clay: Rounded squared seat and layered back pads show real geometry refinement without blob-like upholstery.
